name: idlescreen
description: Lightweight signage dashboard for Cisco Board Pro / RoomOS devices — widgets, photo frame, zero-auth setup

scripts.deploy:site: CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node tools/stamp-version.js && wrangler pages deploy site --project-name signage --branch main --commit-dirty=true && git checkout site/version.json
scripts.deploy:frontdoor: node tools/build-frontdoor.js && wrangler pages deploy dist/frontdoor --project-name quadrille-site --branch main --commit-dirty=true

author: Sean Scott
